rows.en: Both aim to provide a platform for consumers to resolve disputes against service providers.

clarification.en: The Banking Ombudsman is an internal RBI mechanism for banking disputes, whereas Consumer Forums are external judicial bodies for general consumer grievances.
clarification.hi: The Banking Ombudsman is an internal RBI mechanism for banking disputes, whereas Consumer Forums are external judicial bodies for general consumer grievances.

relationship.en: Effective grievance redressal builds trust in the banking system, which is essential for sustained financial inclusion.
